Solid opaque rich ultramarine rounded-square background with only a very subtle smooth gradient. Same ivory keyboard mark centered at same size and position. All content within silhouette fully opaque. Make a polished graphic master that faithfully matches the approved appearance, crisp vector-like geometry, no additional highlights or stylization.
